Blood Banquet

Passive

At the start of the turn, curses the enemy with the highest Attack for 1 turn. When the ally in the back row except for the caster receives lethal damage, consumes 30% of the caster's current Health, dispelling all debuffs from the target, before granting immortality and vampirism for 1 turn. Can only be activated once every 4 turns.
